entities.name: Celâlzâde Mustafa Çelebi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Celâlzâde Mustafa Çelebi was an Ottoman historian and senior bureaucrat. His exact date of birth is unknown, but can be estimated based on information in his writings to be approximately 1490. He was born in Tosya. He was appointed as Reis ül-Küttab in 1524 or 1525; he then served as Nişancı from 1534 until 1557, and again from 1566 until his death. He died in Istanbul.
